Currently when FDB entries are added to or deleted from a VXLAN netdevice
the VXLAN driver emits one notification
attributes. The core however always sends a notification as well
one. Thus two notifications are unnecessarily sent for these operations. A
similar situation comes up with bridge driver
notifications on its own:
# ip link add name vx type vxlan id 1000 dstport 4789
# bridge monitor fdb &
# bridge fdb add de:ad:be:ef:13:37 dev vx self dst 192.0.2.1
de:ad:be:ef:13:37 dev vx dst 192.0.2.1 self permanent
de:ad:be:ef:13:37 dev vx self permanent
In order to prevent this duplicity
bool *notified. The flag is primed to false
column2: and if the callee sends a

column1: notification on its own
it should not generate another notification.
